smooth_profile_refinement.reference_method: 100-digit Decimal quadratic integral with logarithmic/asinh primitive
smooth_profile_refinement.meaning: Profile approximation error, not an error in integrating each linear segment.

limitations: All material values are assumed synthetic controls.
Action sums do not model coherent interface matching or well resonances.
Reversal is at the same incident energy; it is not reverse-bias current.
Published kernels and their constants are unchanged; mismatches remain evidence.
Refining a sampled nonlinear profile changes its approximation, unlike splitting an existing linear segment.

interpretation: Historical local numerical observations. Reassess against declared analytic tolerances on other hosts; do not require bytewise equivalence of host math results.
acceptance_boundary: S3 establishes controlled numerical references with retained negative evidence, not blanket equivalence of published kernels or physical validation of interface scattering.
